## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Distinguish pure tests, real editor checks, and visual checks. Record skipped or unavailable checks instead of marking them as passed.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe effects on existing mods, settings, supported platforms, or the pinned server contract. For source writers, explain how you checked unsaved buffers, undo, encoding, and parent/vanilla protection.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and has appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and user-facing changelog entries are updated, or no update is needed.
- [ ] No game assets, private mod/save data, secrets, generated caches, or packaged binaries are included.
- [ ] External sources are attributed and compatible with the project's GPL-3.0-or-later license.

Do not disclose vulnerabilities here. Follow SECURITY.md for private reporting.
